provenance.notes: installed _muon.py SHA256 matches muon_transition_experiment M0 Gate1 freeze (outputs/m0/muon_freeze.json)

construction.x_def: x[i]=+1 for i in [0,32), -1 for i in [32,64), zero-based index
construction.phase: q in 0..63; step t (1-based) uses i=(t-1+q)%64
construction.phase_reset: both arms start from the shared fixed M0 at every phase

perturbation_scales.field_separation: delta_relative, epsilon_perturb, eps_norm are distinct fields; eps_norm is the NS normalization clamp eps of the installed implementation
perturbation_scales.legacy_note: v2 reported epsilon_perturb=0.001 absolute, NOT delta=0.001; legacy supplement not part of main matrix (not rerun this round; v2 did not record its eps_norm so it is marked not-fully-reproducible)

maps.polar_fp64: ideal full-rank polar factor U V^T (FP64)
maps.finite_ns_fp64: installed semantics (norm().clamp(min=eps) normalization, transpose-if-tall, addmm 3-coefficient quintic, 5 steps) evaluated in FP64; no bf16 cast
maps.native_muon: installed torch.optim path: Muon.step() on a single 2x2 fp32 parameter with fp32 grads; D captured as _zeropower_via_newtonschulz(H_t) with H_t = grad.lerp(buf, momentum) from the live optimizer state; NS internally bf16
maps.shape_scaling: installed adjust_lr_fn=None -> 'original': lr*sqrt(max(1,A/B)); for 2x2 A=B -> factor 1; scaling enters lr only, never D
maps.native_device: cuda:0 (RTX 5090) if free, else cuda:1, else BLOCKED
maps.native_dtype: param/grad/buffer fp32 (matches M1/M2 training), NS internal bfloat16

predictions.nesterov_kernel: w0=1-beta^2; w_j=(1-beta)*beta^(j+1) for j>=1; H_t=beta^(t+1)*M0+sum_j w_j G_{t-j}
predictions.M_scalar: r_ts=trace(C_G(t,s))/trace(Sigma0); C_G_scalar(t,s)=r_ts*Sigma0; same filtering; same J projection; delta=0 returns exact zero
predictions.M_direction: full 4x4 direction cross-covariance through the same filter; C_D_pred(t)=J C_H(t) J^T
predictions.J_source: per-map analytic tangent at H=S (polar: Sylvester solution; finite_ns: E2 recursion incl. normalization branch); native uses the finite_ns_fp64 tangent as its real-arithmetic proxy (bf16 rounding has no derivative); J never fitted from output variances
predictions.full_replay: complete recursion, diagnostic label only, not claimed as a cheap online method

pulse.baseline: G_t=S for all t, M0=S, T=64
pulse.epsilon_pulse_rule: epsilon_pulse = delta_pulse * ||S||_F (single unit-norm direction, no sqrt(2))
pulse.fp64_prediction: w_(t-16)*<Bb, J[Ba or Bs]> for t>=16 (w index t-16, zero for t<16)

statistics.covariance: per-time cross-phase centered covariance first, then average over time
statistics.no_seed_inflation: 64 phases are a finite enumeration population, not 64 independent training seeds

tests.exact_checks: symbol counts and input multiset labels
